tasks.CalculatePrefixSum: Compute the maximum sum of increasing subsequence up to ith index
tasks.CheckKthElementInclusion: Determine if including kth element (k > i) increases the sum
tasks.IncludeKthIfNecessary: Include kth element in the sum only if it increases the total
tasks.VerifySequenceOrder: Ensure the sequence is strictly increasing from start to i
